independence_boundary.rule: expected values must be derived from the source-controlled dataset/query/normalization contracts without calling production exposure, root, query-normalization, gateway, Receipt, or artifact-verification implementations
allowed_inputs: read-only PostgreSQL query results for independently specified SQL
forbidden_inputs: production set digests used as expected values
production result_sha256 used as expected value
credentials, grants, Receipts, ciphertext, or sensitive source rows in an oracle manifest
enforcement: mutation tests against an independently implemented reference model

canonical_fact_id.encoding: length-delimited, domain-separated typed components; no delimiter concatenation

Dependency.S3_and_scale_rule: one base-row Fact and four predicate-field Facts per retained final_v5_exposure_scale row

outputs: per-sample overlap and aggregate membership counts
Outcome.predicate_rule: partition_key=1, family_id=1, member_rank<=N, and metric<=1001.00 produce four distinct atom identities plus one composite identity for the candidate query
Outcome.x1_rule: o0/o50/o90/o100 select 0/15/27/30 overlapping memberships across exactly 30 measured samples

logical_outputs: plaintext logical equality to Baseline S6
runtime_observations_not_predeclared: Parquet binary SHA-256 and byte count
ciphertext object SHA-256 and byte count
Artifact.rule: an oracle never creates or injects the measured Parquet artifact

manifest.canonical_json: known struct field order, no insignificant whitespace, HTML escaping disabled, one final LF, no unknown or duplicate keys
manifest.manifest_sha256: SHA-256 over exact canonical JSON bytes

required_tests: fixed canonical encoding vectors for every supported SQL type including NULL
S3 exact 1k/5k, 10k/50k, and 45k/225k cardinality and digest vectors
Scale prefix set intersection/difference/union vectors at 0/50/90/100 percent
Outcome x1 30-sample schedule and x100/x10k per-sample vectors
S5 branch-order and UNION DISTINCT equivalence vectors
S6 PostgreSQL-versus-Parquet typed logical equality vectors
mutations of key, field, predicate, operator, literal, query identity, result cell, row order, NULL tag, and publication binding must change the relevant digest
large-set tests prove streaming behavior and bounded memory
publication_rule: only oracle spec, counts, and cryptographic digests are publication evidence; raw source rows, Fact IDs, and sensitive values are excluded
freeze_preconditions: all 124 default Baseline/Scale/Artifact manifests are generated
contract and manifest file digests are placed in contracts/index-v1.json
authors review the exact generated bytes
